ask-llm.label: whodar ask --mode llm
ask-llm.note: Recorded on a laptop running a local model (llama3.2 via Ollama), against this same simulated company. It is recorded rather than live because generating a recommendation on a small server without a graphics card takes the better part of a minute, and this public demo runs no model at all. Compare it with the keyword answer beside it: the same person comes first either way. The model does not decide who knows what, it writes the recommendation on top of an answer the graph already worked out.
ask-llm.text:
$ whodar ask --mode llm "kafka consumer lag keeps climbing, who can help"
Who knows about "kafka consumer lag keeps climbing, who can help"
